title: Plural personal pronouns
focus: Learn the subject pronouns for groups and plural address.

exercises.prompt: Which Finnish pronoun means “we”?
exercises.explanation: The speaker and the speaker’s group use me (“we”); the addressed group uses te (“you”); another group is he (“they”).

optionFeedback.me: Correct. The speaker and the speaker’s group use me (“we”); the addressed group uses te (“you”); another group is he (“they”).
optionFeedback.te: The reference does not match. The speaker and the speaker’s group use me (“we”); the addressed group uses te (“you”); another group is he (“they”).
optionFeedback.he: The reference does not match. The speaker and the speaker’s group use me (“we”); the addressed group uses te (“you”); another group is he (“they”).
